title: Inventory: Jerison et al. 2017 (eLife 6:e27167) supplementary bundle
intro: The eLife article page answered 406 to plain requests and the eLife API host is not allowed, so the article
text is the PMC open-access full text (PMC5580887) fetched through NCBI E-utilities
No code repository is cited; the paper deposits sequencing reads at SRA (SRP102877).

Figure 3-source data 1: linear models for adaptability at OT and HT (QTL models; combined fitness + QTL models): term, locus, coefficient, added variance explained.
Figure 6-source data 1: mutual information between de novo mutations and the KRE33 allele, environment and genotype.
Figure 8-source data 1: combined fitness + QTL models for pleiotropy (fitness gains in the environment a population did not evolve in).
roles.elife_poa_e27167_Supplementary_File_1.cs: Supplementary file 1: genotypes of the 230 segregants (adapted from Bloom et al. 2013; semicolon-separated, 4,561 markers named cumulativePos_chr_pos_ref_alt). Not copied to docs/.
roles.elife_poa_e27167_Supplementary_File_2.cs: Supplementary file 2: fitness of each founder (initial, OT and HT, with standard errors) and of each evolved population in both environments.
roles.elife_poa_e27167_Supplementary_File_3.cs: Supplementary file 3: all mutations called at frequency >= 50% in evolved populations.
roles.elife_poa_e27167_Supplementary_File_4.tx: Supplementary file 4: annotated sequence of plasmid pEJ03-mCitrine-KanMX-HO.
roles.elife_poa_e27167_Supplementary_File_5.cs: Supplementary file 5: QTL locations (8 loci, peak position only), genes within confidence intervals, and y/n membership for 8 traits. Core input.

missing: No numeric confidence-interval bounds and no LOD for any QTL: Supplementary file 5 gives the locus position and the genes inside the 1.5-LOD interval only.
No coefficients for the initial-fitness QTL (only the adaptability and pleiotropy models in Figure 3/8 source data have coefficients).
